items.title: Finite generation of the units modulo constants under any one of three additional hypotheses
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The proposition proves finite generation of O(X)^*/k^* for a connected reduced locally finite type scheme with finitely many irreducible components, provided at least one of three conditions holds: the integral closure of k in the global sections is k, X has a k-rational point, or X is geometrically integral. The proof passes to a connected component Y of the reduced geometric base change, applies the algebraically closed case to Y, and uses it to produce, under the failure of finite generation, an element f of O(X) not in k whose image under O(X) -> O(Y) lies in the algebraic closure (proof lines 5363-5383). It then shows that conditions (2) and (3) each imply condition (1): a k-rational point gives a section of the inclusion k -> O(X), forcing the integral closure to be k, and geometric integrality gives the same conclusion through the integral closure being a field (proof lines 5384-5403). H3: the passage to the geometric base change and the comparison of the three hypotheses is independent work.
